status: final; approved by the researcher on 2026-09-29 (all proposed thresholds, budget, seed band, calibration count and telemetry accepted)
question: Is causal_gradient_alignment an effective membership attack by itself, with no guard in the loop?

cohort.role: attacker validation only; never used to fit or threshold a detector
cohort.exclusions: smoke target; every group of each supplied guard_splits_v2 manifest (guard-v3 and guard-v4 pilot splits, the v4 pilot cohort.json including its role 'final' reserved targets); Stage A targets for Stage B
cohort.resolution: CPU target resolution and exclusion by collect_guard_traces resolve before any GPU job; a collision means preparing a new directory with fresh seeds in the band, never editing a launch

job.training: Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct @ 7ae557604adf67be50417f59c2c2f167def9a775; squad_research @ 7b6d24c440a36b6815f21b70d25016731768db1f; 4 clients, 4 per round, 3 rounds, 1 local epoch, batch 2, lr 2e-5, max_length 128

telemetry: Each observed trial and each calibration batch records dot(released, direction), ||released|| and ||direction|| (server-observable). No gradients or private text are stored.

stage_a.selection: arm x score with the highest mean per-target ROC AUC; ties go to fewer probe_epochs, then projection
stage_a.after: Stage A targets are consumed and excluded from Stage B

endpoints.primary: mean of per-target ROC AUC (members vs nonmembers, ties count 1/2) with a 95% percentile interval from 10,000 bootstrap resamples of targets (numpy default_rng seed 20260929)
endpoints.operating_point: per target, threshold = calibration.nonmember_threshold(selected score on that target's public calibration batches, 0.05); TPR and FPR on its private trials; pooled as ratios of sums with the same target bootstrap
endpoints.paired: fraction of batch pairs with member score > nonmember score (ties 1/2); exact one-sided sign test over non-tied pairs; target bootstrap interval
endpoints.negative_control: within-pair label swaps: 10,000 Monte Carlo permutations (seed 20260929) of each target's AUC and of the pooled mean AUC; report the observed values' null percentiles

decision.effective: pooled mean AUC 95% lower bound >= 0.60: detector work on causal requests is justified; proceed to matched-reference benign controls
decision.not_effective: pooled mean AUC 95% upper bound < 0.60: stop escalating the causal-request detector and record a negative result
decision.inconclusive: otherwise; any extension needs a new pre-registration, never added targets after seeing results
decision.calibration_failure: pooled private FPR 95% lower bound > 0.10: public calibration does not transfer; operational claims only at FPR measured on private data

not_shown: One attack family, one model (Qwen2.5-0.5B), batch size 4, no observation noise.
Nothing about the detector, enforced guard runs, adaptive evasion or utility.
Results on this cohort must not tune the detector or its threshold.
